verified_against_live_ui.notes: robots /search disallowed; one-off owner-authorized paced capture 2026-10-12 (Ferosh, handoff 03). Control term 'charcoal': one plain GET of /search?q=charcoal&type=product (live results page, 91 results, 36 per page) vs one GET of /search/suggest (the predictive dropdown the search box calls). Top 8 titles identical and in the same order; positions 9-10 differ in order only (predictive: Quick Light Large, Fire Bowl XL, Quick Light Medium; results page: Quick Light Large, Quick Light Medium, Quick Light XL&2XL, Fire Bowl XL). Count differs only because predictive is capped at 10 products; profiled_count is therefore the dropdown cap, not a total. Predictive total is a lower bound (max 10); coverage (zero vs non-zero) and top-10 ranking are what is measured.

limitations: robots.txt Disallows /search; capture was a one-off owner-authorized paced run (2026-10-12), not a standing change.
Predictive endpoint returns at most 10 products, so per-term total is capped at 10 (lower bound); the full results-page count was not captured (would double the load).
Live-UI gate compared the results page to the predictive endpoint rather than a rendered dropdown; top-8 identical, positions 9-10 order differs.
